get_config_default: get the default transformer experiment config for Omniglot image classification training
get_config_debug: get a reduced transformer experiment config with fewer layers and heads for debugging
configure_zipf_exponent: set the ZIPF_EXPONENT constant to control Zipf distribution for data generation
configure_eval_modes: configure evaluation modes based on whether ZIPF_EXPONENT is zero or non-zero
configure_model_architecture: configure the transformer or RNN model architecture with layers, heads, and hidden size
